canonical_journal_interpretation.preprint_relationship: The preprint is prior/background evidence. It is not the journal experiment and does not predetermine the journal-primary model.
canonical_journal_interpretation.track_a_relationship: Track A is one comprehensive model-neutral journal experiment executed in multiple computational waves. Earlier completed states and later locked states are components of the same journal Track-A programme.
canonical_journal_interpretation.protocol_revision_relationship: Historical v1/v1.1/v1.2 amendment filenames and chronology are preserved for provenance. For journal interpretation, the later locks correct and complete the comprehensive Track-A design before its final closure; they are not presented as a separate scientific study.
canonical_journal_interpretation.history_policy: Do not rewrite or delete historical evidence, commits, filenames, results or lock artifacts solely to simplify manuscript narrative. Reconcile them through this additive authority layer.
canonical_journal_interpretation.cross_track_rule: Track A selects the scientific primary model. Track B evaluates external generalization and Track C evaluates deployment/runtime only after Track-A selection is sealed. Track-B or Track-C outcomes may not alter Track-A scientific selection.

prospective_internal_test_rule.when: Only after the Track-A journal-primary architecture and exact selected checkpoint are irreversibly sealed.
prospective_internal_test_rule.purpose: One-shot internal held-out performance estimation after all validation-driven model selection is complete.

execution_resources.scientific_process_model: two independent single-GPU children per account; no DDP/DataParallel/FSDP

pre_science_gates: v1.2 and additive correction-lock integrity PASS
R13 exact architecture/runtime/XAI target qualification PASS
G1A exact pretrained and deterministic initialization identities PASS for every remaining state
G2A execution/calibration qualification PASS for every architecture-resource profile that is not already covered by reusable evidence
science-diff confirms completed historical evidence and scientific semantics are unchanged
analysis and final model-selection implementations are deterministic and tested
six-GPU scheduler preserves frozen experiment IDs, seeds, configs, initializations and checkpoint lineage
science_authorization_rule: This file does not authorize scientific execution. Authorization requires a later exact-head qualification artifact showing every pre-science gate PASS.
